channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermeneutic (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermeneutic is a Python tool that mines corrections from AI agent session logs into a local retrieval index, then surfaces relevant past guidance when a similar task comes up. It also provides a draft gate that flags risky English wording with PASS or RISK before a response is sent. The README notes the gate matches fixed surface patterns and cannot determine whether a claim is true.

item.title: rule-audit (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: rule-audit is a static analyzer for AI system prompts that parses a prompt into normative rules and reports logical contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities, meta-rule paradoxes, and absolute-rule edge cases without calling an LLM. It is distributed as a Python package and CLI, and also runs as a pre-commit hook that audits agent rules and prompts before they are committed. The repository root is a portable Agent Plugin shipping one skill, with host-specific installs for Claude Code,

item.title: senpi-plugin (Domain Applications)
item.description: Senpi connects Hermes Agent to a user's hosted Senpi AI quant for Hyperliquid through an OAuth-authenticated MCP server and a companion skill. It supports market reads, ranked signals, wallet and trader research, portfolio analysis, and strategy design without requiring a deposit; Senpi documents a separate allow-once approval for proposed trades or fund movements, while deposits and withdrawals remain in its app.

item.title: astro-agents-mcp (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Astro Agents is a hosted MCP server that computes Western and Vedic astrology charts for AI agents, resolving time zones and historical offsets from coordinates. It uses NASA/JPL DE440 positions and returns deterministic results with SHA-256 input and result hashes that can be recomputed via a verification tool or REST endpoint. The repository documents the service and carries its MCP registry manifest; the engine runs at the hosted endpoint.

item.title: little-canary (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Little Canary screens untrusted prompts for signs of injection by sending the text to a powerless canary model with no tools or credentials, then inspecting the model's response for behavioral changes. It returns a PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK verdict for the host to enforce, with structural pattern checks running alongside. The README states the project publishes its corpora and method rather than a detection-rate headline.

item.title: ai-project-advisor (Domain Applications)
item.description: AI Project Advisor is a construction management tool that integrates with WeCom, DingTalk, and H5 to convert chat messages into structured project records. It utilizes a hybrid engine combining rule-based processing for data entry with an LLM fallback for general inquiries and summaries.

item.title: memanto (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memanto is a Memory Agent that runs alongside other agents to manage their memories: extracting durable knowledge from conversations, consolidating duplicates, reconciling contradictions, forgetting stale items, and briefing agents before they act. It installs via pip, npm, or Go, and connects to agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex without code changes. It can run locally with Docker and Ollama, or in the cloud, and exports memory in the Open Knowledge Format.

item.title: agent-context-os (Memory & Context)
item.description: Context OS is a Git-backed context and workflow layer that keeps durable project context and workflows in plain Markdown files that supported coding agents can read and update through reviewed handoffs. It provides first-class adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Devin CLI, and Hermes Agent, routing them to shared repository state through a deterministic lifecycle kernel. Imports are selective, browser-project sync is manual, and external capabilities remain opt-in.

item.title: hermes-tool-slimmer (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Tool Slimmer is a plugin for Hermes Agent designed to reduce the token overhead of model requests by trimming tool schemas. It uses BM25 ranking to select relevant tools based on the user's request while maintaining a fallback mechanism for the model to request the full tool catalog.

item.title: ekko-studio (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console. It connects Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, bringing conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together. It ships as a desktop app for Windows/macOS/Linux, an npm CLI package, and a Docker image.

item.title: incise (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Incise is a CLI and agent-tool backend for making precise, byte-preserving edits to Markdown tables, lists, sections, and YAML frontmatter. Callers specify what should change by content-based addresses, and deterministic code handles formatting, boundaries, and the smallest possible splice. It is intended for AI-maintained documentation, Obsidian vaults, Markdown knowledge bases, and local models with limited context.

item.title: leverage (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Leverage provides a registry of skills and packaged workflows for AI agents, enabling them to access live social media data, company enrichment, and outreach tools. It integrates with agents via the agentskills.io standard and an MCP server to provide structured data from platforms like LinkedIn, X, and Reddit.

item.title: llm-wiki-cli (Memory & Context)
item.description: LWC is an agent-driven proactive memory CLI that lets AI agents recall, maintain, and evolve persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. It turns curated documents into a durable Wiki with preserved sources, pages, citations, links, indexes, and history, and it does not require embeddings or a vector database. A self-hosted team memory option keeps core memory in local SQLite and Wiki files synchronized through a self-hosted server.

item.title: token-saver (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Token Saver is a Hermes Agent plugin that calculates the hypothetical cost of local AI inference based on live OpenRouter pricing. It tracks token usage from local providers like Ollama and LM Studio to visualize simulated savings through a web dashboard, TUI widget, and slash commands.

item.title: deja-vu (Memory & Context)
item.description: deja-vu indexes the session history that coding agents already save to disk, making months of past sessions searchable across agents. It provides recall at session start, before file edits or commands, and after command failures, and can resume or continue sessions in other agents. It is distributed as a single Go binary for macOS, Linux and Windows.

item.title: smartnumbers-hermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes plugin receives and archives Smartnumbers conversation transcripts to extract durable memory and automate post-call agent reviews. It queues asynchronous tasks for a Hermes agent to process transcripts using natural-language instructions and configured toolsets after a call concludes.

item.title: hermes-codex-skin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Codex Skin is a community plugin that applies a Codex-inspired chat layout and theme to Hermes Desktop, with options for composer width, pinned messages, clean transcript, and an optional task Inbox. It is installed through the Desktop Plugin SDK or by manually placing plugin.js in a local plugin folder, and it can check GitHub for stable releases with user-confirmed updates. The README states it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nous Research or OpenAI.

item.title: hermes-memoss (Developer Tools)
item.description: MemOS Memory Plugin for Hermes Agent connects to a self-hosted MemOS instance to provide persistent memory storage. It enables semantic search, fact extraction, and automatic synchronization of conversation turns.

item.title: hermes-hud (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a local-first, read-only monitoring plugin for the Hermes Agent dashboard that provides real-time observability of system health, token usage, and session activity. It operates as a user-level extension using a shared snapshot cache and WebSocket events to display metrics without outbound telemetry.

item.title: hermes-hud (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a terminal-based consciousness monitor and dashboard for Hermes AI agents. It reads data from the agent's local directory to display live information regarding memory, tool usage, project status, and error logs.

item.title: skill-evolution (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Skill Evolution is a Python-based framework for autonomous agent skill improvement that analyzes past sessions to generate structured proposals. It features an evaluation gate with multiple evaluators and host-agnostic adapters for Hermes and Claude Code.

item.title: cli (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: SandBase CLI is an open-source command-line tool that connects AI clients to AI models and APIs through the Model Context Protocol. It runs a local MCP bridge, requiring a one-time browser authorization, after which supported clients can discover, inspect, and run available SandBase models and APIs. A read-only catalog command lists a verified 25-client catalog.

item.title: hermes-ai-usage (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes AI Usage Monitor is a read-only extension for Hermes Agent that provides telemetry for provider quotas and local token usage. It supports the native Desktop app and Web Dashboard, displaying session history and consumption metrics without reading prompt or message content.

item.title: hermes-speech (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Speech is a plugin for Hermes Agent 0.20+ that integrates text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities through the AllModels API. It enables conversational setup, voice searching, and streaming audio using Hermes' native provider interfaces and bundled dependencies.

item.title: hermes-live-voice (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Live Voice is a community integration that lets you talk to Hermes Agent while it runs background tasks, with results retained when you reconnect. It supports OpenAI Realtime by default, plus Gemini and local Hugging Face voice options. The Dashboard connects to a private gateway, while Hermes owns conversation history, memory, tools, and task execution.

item.title: agent-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: agent-skills is a collection of drop-in markdown skill files that teach coding agents specific workflows, installable into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. Skills cover session management, code review, eval integrity, reconciliation, SSOT checks, worktree recovery, and skill scaffolding, with a bundled installer handling installs, diffs, and updates. The project is in maintenance mode, receiving security fixes but no planned new features.

item.title: agent-memory-kit (Memory & Context)
item.description: agent-memory-kit is a file-based curation loop designed to identify contradictions and outdated information within an agent's memory store. It uses a set of five markdown-based commands to capture, recall, and audit memory through evidence-cited diffs without requiring a database or vector store.

item.title: hermes-startup (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes Startup is a local-first skill for Hermes Agent designed to help users identify and test business ideas. The tool uses a series of focused questions to generate evidence-labeled ideas and prepares reversible tests for chosen problems.

item.title: demo-gif-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This project is a skill for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents that automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories. It generates recording scripts using vhs for terminal interfaces or Playwright for web applications, then renders, optimizes, and embeds the resulting GIF into the README.

item.title: agent-skill-builder (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: agent-skill-builder is a tool for generating and validating Claude Code and portable Agent Skills using plain-language descriptions. It includes a runtime-aware validator that detects structural drift, unsafe commands, and credential-shaped strings while enforcing specific character limits for each profile.
